info.name: FnCS_Casestudy2
info.description: Requests for every endpoint of the assignment, with tests. Start the application with a fresh database (./mvnw quarkus:dev -Dquarkus.http.port=8081) and run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, top to bottom.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness and readiness probes from quarkus-smallrye-health.

exec: pm.test("database check is listed", function () { pm.expect(json.checks.some(c => c.name === "Database connections health check")).to.be.true; });

request.description: Readiness includes the datasource check. If the database is down this returns 503, so traffic stops going to the app.

item.name: Task 2 - Store
item.description: Store CRUD. Changes reach the legacy system only after the transaction commits: watch the application log for "Legacy system notified".

exec: pm.test("seed store present", function () { pm.expect(json.some(s => s.name === "TONSTAD")).to.be.true; });

request.description: Created after commit; the log shows "Legacy system notified: Store created" with the generated id.

item.name: Create duplicate name (rollback, no legacy call)

exec: pm.test("conflict message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "A record with the same unique value already exists").to.be.true; });

request.description: The unique constraint fails on commit and the transaction rolls back. The log must NOT show "Legacy system notified" for this request (Task 2).

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Id was invalidly set on request.").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Store Name was not set on request.").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Quantity of products in stock cannot be negative.").to.be.true; });

request.description: The legacy system receives the saved store, including its id (before the fix it received the request body without id).
Before the fix, sending only a name reset the stock to 0.
Before the fix, PATCH without a name was rejected with 422.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Store with id of 9999 does not exist.").to.be.true; });
pm.test("seed product present", function () { pm.expect(json.some(p => p.name === "KALLAX")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("conflict message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "A record with the same unique value already exists").to.be.true; });

request.description: Unique name, enforced by the database.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Product price cannot be negative.").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Product with id of 9999 does not exist.").to.be.true; });

item.name: Task 3 - Warehouse
item.description: Warehouse create, get, archive and replace with all business rules. Rule violations return 400 as declared in the OpenAPI spec.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Warehouse with id '999' does not exist").to.be.true; });
pm.test("created with id", function () { pm.expect(json.id !== undefined).to.be.true; });

request.description: All rules pass: new code, existing location, room for another warehouse, enough capacity, stock within capacity.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Business unit code 'MWH.001' already exists").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Location 'PARIS-001' does not exist").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Location 'ZWOLLE-001' already has the maximum number of warehouses (1)").to.be.true; });

request.description: Creation feasibility: ZWOLLE-001 allows one warehouse.

item.name: Create: capacity above what the location has left

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Capacity 60 exceeds the available capacity 50 of location 'AMSTERDAM-001'").to.be.true; });

request.description: Capacity validation: AMSTERDAM-001 has 100 in total and MWH.012 already uses 50.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Stock (11) exceeds the warehouse capacity (10)").to.be.true; });

item.name: Replace: capacity cannot hold current stock

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Capacity 20 cannot accommodate the stock 27 of the replaced warehouse").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Stock 20 must match the stock 27 of the replaced warehouse").to.be.true; });

item.name: Replace: no active warehouse with the code

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "No active warehouse with business unit code 'MWH.999'").to.be.true; });

request.description: TILBURG-001 allows one warehouse, but the one being replaced does not count. The old record is archived and kept as history.

item.name: Old warehouse is archived after replacement

request.description: Sets archivedAt; the row stays in the database.

item.name: Create: archived code cannot be reused

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Business unit code 'MWH.100' already exists").to.be.true; });

request.description: A code only comes back through a replacement.

item.name: Bonus - Fulfilment
item.description: Warehouses as fulfilment units of products for stores. Limits: 2 warehouses per product and store, 3 warehouses per store, 5 product types per warehouse. Run after the Task 3 folder.

request.description: A fourth active warehouse, needed to show the store limit.

item.name: Assign warehouse to product and store

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Warehouse MWH.001 already fulfils product 2 for store 1").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Product 2 is already fulfilled by 2 warehouses for store 1").to.be.true; });

request.description: Max 2 warehouses per product and store.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Store 1 is already fulfilled by 3 warehouses").to.be.true; });

request.description: Extra product types for the warehouse limit.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "Warehouse MWH.200 already stores 5 product types").to.be.true; });
pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "No active warehouse with business unit code 'NOPE'.").to.be.true; });

request.description: Only active warehouses can be assigned.

exec: pm.test("message", function () { pm.expect(json.error === "storeId, productId and businessUnitCode are required.").to.be.true; });

item.name: Replace a warehouse that has assignments

request.description: The replacement keeps the business unit code.

item.name: Assignments carry over to the replacement

exec: pm.test("three assignments for store 1", function () { pm.expect(json.length === 3).to.be.true; });
pm.test("MWH.012 still listed", function () { pm.expect(json.some(a => a.businessUnitCode === "MWH.012")).to.be.true; });

request.description: Assignments reference the business unit code, so nothing has to be migrated on replacement.
